title: Book a room
story: As a member, I want to book a free room for a time slot so that I have a place to meet.
acceptance_criteria: AC-101-1 Book a free room on a 30-minute grid, 201 with the booking | AC-101-2 Duration between 30 minutes and 4 hours | AC-101-3 Inside opening hours 08:00-20:00, ending at 20:00 allowed | AC-101-4 Start must be in the future

title: No double booking
story: As a member, I want a room never to be booked twice at the same time.
acceptance_criteria: AC-102-1 Active bookings of a room cannot overlap | AC-102-2 A booking can start when another ends | AC-102-3 Other rooms do not conflict

title: Respect room capacity
story: As a facility manager, I want bookings to respect the room capacity.
acceptance_criteria: AC-103-1 Attendees between 1 and capacity | AC-103-2 Exactly the capacity is accepted

title: Cancel a booking
story: As a member, I want to cancel my booking so that the room can be used by someone else.
acceptance_criteria: AC-104-1 Cancel own booking up to 24h before start | AC-104-2 Within 24h a member cannot cancel | AC-104-3 Cancelled booking keeps status cancelled | AC-104-4 Cancelling twice is refused

title: Release cancelled slots
story: As a member, I want a cancelled slot to be bookable again.
acceptance_criteria: AC-105-1 Same room and slot can be booked again | AC-105-2 Availability shows the slot as free

title: Manager privileges
story: As a manager, I want to manage bookings for the whole site.
acceptance_criteria: AC-106-1 Manager can cancel any booking at any time | AC-106-2 Manager can book on behalf of a member | AC-106-3 Member cannot book on behalf of someone else

title: Booking visibility
story: As a member, I want my bookings to be private.
acceptance_criteria: AC-107-1 Member reads and lists only own bookings | AC-107-2 Reading another member's booking is refused | AC-107-3 Manager reads and lists all

title: Weekly recurring bookings
story: As a member, I want to book the same slot for several weeks in one go.
acceptance_criteria: AC-108-1 Weekly repeat for 1 to 8 occurrences | AC-108-2 Same weekday times room attendees | AC-108-3 If one occurrence fails none is created | AC-108-4 More than 8 refused

title: Booking quota
story: As a facility manager, I want to limit how many future bookings a member holds.
acceptance_criteria: AC-109-1 At most 5 active future bookings | AC-109-2 Each occurrence counts | AC-109-3 Cancelled bookings do not count | AC-109-4 Managers have no quota

title: Reschedule a booking
story: As a member, I want to move my booking instead of cancelling and rebooking.
acceptance_criteria: AC-110-1 Owner changes start end attendees | AC-110-2 Same rules as a new booking | AC-110-3 No conflict with itself | AC-110-4 24h notice before current start

title: Room availability
story: As a member, I want to see when a room is free on a given day.
acceptance_criteria: AC-111-1 Free windows inside opening hours in order | AC-111-2 Booked periods excluded | AC-111-3 Cancelled bookings do not reduce availability

title: Flexible cancellation for loyal members
story: As a loyal member, I want a more flexible cancellation policy.
acceptance_criteria: AC-112-1 Loyal members get better cancellation conditions

title: Limit bookings too far ahead
story: As a facility manager, I do not want members to block rooms too far in advance.
acceptance_criteria: AC-113-1 Bookings cannot be made too far in the future

title: Deal with no-shows
story: As a facility manager, I want to deal with members who book a room and do not use it.
